author: Inside Edition
description: The ex-wife of Republican Ohio congressman Max Miller is accusing him of abuse. Miller denies the allegations, and is refusing to step down. Now his own former father-in-law, Senator Bernie Moreno, is going public, saying Miller is not fit for office. In a social media statement, Moreno said of Miller, “He is a danger to my daughter, and I hold my breath every minute he has custody of my granddaughter.” Miller is locked in a tight race for reelection against Democrat Brian Poindexter.
title: Ohio Congressman Denies Abuse Allegations Made By Ex-Wife And Her Senator Dad

author: Inside Edition
description: This outdoorsman may be one of the most fearless men in America. Fishing guide Carter Brown was on a boat in a scenic part of Alaska when he encountered a grizzly bear in the water. Brown managed to take a smiling selfie with the bear right behind him, as the creature ate a salmon it had just caught. A second bear was also visible in the background. Brown's calm composure has earned him the title "Mr. Cool."
title: Fishing Guide Takes Calm Selfie With Grizzly Bear Right Behind Him

author: Inside Edition
description: This story may help restore your faith in humanity: a Ring doorbell camera caught a stranger knocking on someone's front door in McDonough, Georgia. It turns out Cameron Johnson was doing a good deed: returning a cash-filled wallet a man had lost while shopping at Walmart. Cameron went above and beyond to make sure it was safely returned to its rightful owner. Inside Edition's Alison Hall has more.
title: Stranger Returns Cash-Filled Wallet Lost At Walmart

author: Inside Edition
description: A boater on a mission to clean up New Jersey's wetlands ended up with an unusual find, over 50 years in the making. The old Coca-Cola bottle John Kauterman found as part of the Tidelands Initiative contained a decades-old message that was still legible. It was written by a little girl named Laurie in 1973 during a trip to Ocean City. After posting the message on Facebook, John was able to get in touch with Laurie's sister.
title: New Jersey Boater Finds 5-Decades-Old Message-In-A-Bottle

author: Inside Edition
description: It's now been more than six months since Savannah Guthrie's mother Nancy was kidnapped from her Arizona home. There have been no major breaks in the case. Now a blistering report in the Wall Street Journal accuses the Pima County Sheriff's Department of mishandling the investigation. The report describes what it calls a string of costly blunders in the crucial hours after Nancy Guthrie vanished. The Sheriff disputes the allegations in the Wall Street Journal report. Inside Edition's new reporter Andrea Grymes has the latest.
title: Sheriff's Department Accused Of Blunders In Nancy Guthrie Kidnapping Case

author: Inside Edition
description: Wildfires are spreading through Spokane, Washington, in what is being called the worst natural disaster to ever hit the region by the city's mayor. More than 600 structures, including homes, have been destroyed by the flames. Officials have been going door to door telling people to evacuate. A homeowner who was able to prevent his home from going up in flames talked to CBS News. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Wildfires Burn Across Spokane In Unprecedented Natural Disaster

author: Inside Edition
description: Unusually hot, dry weather has helped bring a prehistoric creature to light. The remains of a woolly mammoth are being recovered from the banks of the Danube River in Bulgaria, as low water levels reveal things long-buried in the river mud. So far, paleontologists have recovered the lower jaw, tusks, a shoulder blade, and ribs from the mammoth. They hope to find the rest of its skeleton still underground.
title: Drought Conditions Reveal Woolly Mammoth Skeleton

author: Inside Edition
description: The murders of Prince Teddy Khedker and his wife Nenescha shocked their Upper East Side neighborhood.
title: Who Murdered Indian Prince On Park Avenue? #shorts
